cases.name: the rust failure pattern also matches a passing test
caught_by: the rust failure pattern reads no failure in a clean rust run (it found ['a_unit_test', 'b_unit_test'])
the rust dialect names the failing test

cases.name: the node failure pattern also matches a passing case
caught_by: a node --test failure is read through the node dialect
the node dialect does not count the per-file wrapper as a test
the node failure pattern reads no failure in a clean node run (it found ['a named case'])

cases.name: the pytest failure pattern matches nothing at all
caught_by: a pytest failure is read through the pytest dialect
a pytest ERROR counts as a catch, not as a clean run
the pytest dialect names the failing test

cases.name: the go report pattern stops seeing a clean package line
caught_by: a go test failure is read through the go dialect
a cached go result is not a suite that reported
a go build failure with a package name is not a suite that reported
a go build error is not read as a suite that reported
the go dialect sees the clean run report
